brief: A small candle studio in Asheville, North Carolina. We hand-pour soy candles in three scents, cedar and smoke, fig and black tea, and wild mint, each in an 8 oz or a 16 oz jar. We also sell wax melts in the same scents, a gift set with one candle and a pack of melts, and matchboxes with our logo. Warm, simple tone.

candidates.note: A reference answer written by hand: one product for each thing the brief sells, options only where the brief gives the choices, gaps marked where a shopper needs a fact the brief does not give, and no price.
